lessons.title: The print() Function
lessons.summary: The print() function outputs text or numbers onto your screen. Learn its syntax and quote rules.
learningObjectives: Understand how print() displays data to the screen
Learn how quotation marks define text strings
Write and run your first Python program

sections.title: How print() Works
sections.content:
The `print()` function is used to output text or data onto your screen.

### Syntax

```python
print("Your message goes here")
```

| Component | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| `print` | The built-in instruction telling Python to display something. |
| `( )` | Parentheses hold the data you want to display (arguments). |
| `" "` | Quotation marks mark the text inside as a string literal. |

terms.definition: A set of ordered instructions written in code for a computer to execute.
